dominant_strengths: Italic serif 'Oneiro' wordmark in violet pairs poetically with monospace UI labels, creating a distinct dual-voice identity.
Restrained dark palette with a single saturated violet accent gives the form clear hierarchy and emotional calm.
Tight minimalist composition: only essential fields, generous vertical rhythm, no decorative noise.
dominant_weaknesses: Inputs lack visible borders or fill contrast against the panel, making fields nearly invisible until hovered or focused.
The CONTINUE button's saturated violet block feels heavy and disconnected from the otherwise whisper-quiet interface tone.
Panel sits as a flat rectangle on pure black with no elevation, glow, or framing, weakening focal anchoring.
fix_priorities: Strengthen input affordance with a subtle 1px border or slightly lighter fill so fields read without hover.
Soften the CTA: lower saturation, add subtle gradient or inset, or match button weight to the typographic restraint.
Add a soft violet glow or border to the card to tie it to the wordmark and lift it from the void.
Introduce focus/hover micro-transitions to give the static form behavioral life.
rationale.norman_balance: Reflective branding ('Oneiro' serif, monospace) edges ahead of visceral polish, while behavioral clarity suffers from near-invisible inputs.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes—it functions as a credible sign-in screen with proper fields, CTA, and account-creation link, though usability friction undercuts the poetic framing.
